account.displayNameHint: This is how others see you.
account.usernameHint: You sign in with it. You can change it later in your profile.
account.usernameRules: 2 to 64 characters: a to z, digits, dot, hyphen, underscore.
account.emailHint: Optional. You can also sign in with it and reset a forgotten password.
account.wrong: Username, email or password is wrong.
account.setupCodeHint: It is in the server's log (docker logs {{app}}), or set {{setupTokenEnv}}.
account.forgotSent: If there is an account with an address for this, a link is on its way.
account.forgotNoMail: The operator can make you a link under Accounts to set a new password.
account.emailTaken: This address belongs to another account already.
account.passwordMismatch: The two passwords are not the same.
account.confirmFresh: Confirm with a fresh sign-in at your provider.
account.formerUsername: The old username stays reserved for you. You sign in with the new one only.
account.emailConfirmSent: A link to confirm is on its way to {{email}}. Until then your current address counts.
account.emailDuplicate: Another account has this address too. It does not count for signing in.
account.resetLinkSent: The link is on its way to {{email}}.
account.resetLinkShown: Pass this link on. It works only once.
account.resetByOperator: The operator made you a link for a new password.
account.secondFactorHint: When you sign in, {{app}} also asks for a code from your authenticator app or for a passkey.
account.totpScan: Scan the QR code with your authenticator app and enter the code it shows.
account.totpKey: Or enter this key by hand:
account.totpOn: The authenticator app is set up.
account.codeHint: 6 digits from the authenticator app, or one of your recovery codes.
account.recoveryCodesHint: Each code works once, for when your phone is not at hand. Keep them safe: they are shown only now.
account.factorRequired: Every account on this server needs a second factor. Set it up now.
account.factorRequiredSwitch: Require a second factor of everybody
account.factorRequiredSwitchHint: On: every account without a second factor sets one up at its next sign-in. A passkey counts.
account.factorRequiredExempt: Accounts from a sign-in provider bring the provider's. An account with a password is not affected either when it comes in through a provider for which “{{trusts}}” is on.
account.factorRequiredExemptLocked: Not affected is whoever signs in through a provider for which “{{trusts}}” is on.
account.secondFactorOffHint: {{secondFactorOffEnv}} is set: nobody is asked for a second factor. Remove the variable and restart {{app}} once you can get in again.
account.factorResetHint: Removes this account's authenticator app and recovery codes and signs it out everywhere.
account.factorResetDevices: Disconnect the paired devices too (a lost phone stays signed in otherwise)
account.passkeysHint: Sign in with your fingerprint, face or the device's PIN, without a password.
account.passkeysNeedAddress: Passkeys need the public address with https. Enter it first:
account.passkeysNeedAddressMember: Passkeys need the public address with https. The operator has to enter it first.
account.signOutEverywhereHint: Signs out every other browser and paired device. Calendar programs, API keys and passkeys stay.
account.newSignInMail: Mail me about a new sign-in
account.newSignInMailHint: When somebody signs in from a browser {{app}} does not know yet.
account.pictureHint: Every signed-in account on this server sees it.
account.sessionExpiredHint: Sign in again. What you wrote on this page is kept.
account.setupSubtitle: The first account belongs to the operator: with it you invite others and manage {{app}}.
account.askChangeUsername: {{name}} then signs in with the new username. The old one stays reserved for this account.
account.askMakeOperator: {{name}} can then manage every account and the settings of {{app}}.
account.askMakeMember: {{name}} can then no longer manage accounts or the settings of {{app}}.
account.askEmailRemove: {{email}} then no longer belongs to this account. {{name}} signs in with the username.
account.askResetLink: With the link, {{name}} sets a new password themselves. You never learn it.
account.askSignOut: {{name}} is signed out of every browser and paired device. Calendar programs, API keys and passkeys stay.
account.askUnlink: {{name}} can then no longer sign in through {{provider}}.
account.askBlock: {{name}} can no longer sign in and is signed out everywhere. Everything in the account stays.
account.askRemove: The account of {{name}} will be deleted.
account.askRemoveDays_one: You can restore it for {{count}} day.
account.askRemoveDays_other: You can restore it for {{count}} days.
account.askRestore: {{name}} can sign in again, and everything in the account is back.
account.askInviteWithdraw: The link of this invitation then no longer works.
account.inviteEmailHint: Optional. The person sees it when accepting and can change it.
account.inviteSent: The invitation is on its way to {{email}}.
account.inviteLinkHint: Pass this link on. It works until {{day}}.
account.emailProveSent: A link to confirm is on its way to {{email}}.

error.display_name_taken: Someone shows this display name already.
error.email_invalid: This is not an email address.

error.fresh_sign_in_needed: Sign in at your provider again for this.
error.account_blocked: This account is blocked. Ask the operator.
error.not_allowed: Only the operator may do this.
error.use_account_page: Change your own password in your profile.
error.password_login_off: Signing in with a password is off. This account signs in through a provider.
error.invite_invalid: This invitation has been used already or is not valid any more.
error.reset_invalid: This link has been used already or is not valid any more.
error.email_link_invalid: This link has been used already or is not valid any more.
error.no_pending_email: No address waits for its link.
error.enrolment_expired: That took too long. Start again.
error.sign_in_expired: That took too long. Sign in again.
error.factor_missing: Set up a second factor first.
error.factor_required: A second factor is required here. Set up another one first.
error.passkeys_off: Passkeys are turned off on this server.
error.passkey_invalid: This passkey did not sign you in.
error.passkey_expired: That took too long. Try again.
error.too_many_passkeys: No more passkeys fit. Remove one first.
error.too_many_attempts: Too many attempts. Wait a moment.
error.avatar_too_large: The picture is larger than {{mb}} MB.
error.avatar_not_a_picture: This is not a picture we can read.
error.avatars_busy: Too many pictures at once. Try again in a moment.
error.public_url_needed: The link needs the public address of {{app}}. Enter it in the server settings.
error.nothing_to_prove: There is no address left to confirm by link.
error.unknown: That did not work. Try again.
error.cannot_demote_self: You do not change your own role here.
error.cannot_block_self: You do not block your own account.
error.cannot_delete_self: You do not delete your own account here.
error.last_operator: {{app}} needs at least one operator who can sign in.
error.invalid_limit: The limit is a number from 0, at most 10 TB.
error.theme_invalid: Choose Light, Dark or Like the system.
error.provider_first: Without an active sign-in provider, signing in with a password stays on.
error.own_second_factor_first: Set up a second factor of your own first.

account.ownSecondFactorFirst: Set up a second factor of your own first (My account › Security), or you would be the first one locked out.
account.factorRequiredOffText: A password alone gets into an account again then. Whoever has a second factor already keeps it.
account.passkeysAllowedHint: Sign in with a fingerprint, a face or the device's PIN, without a password.
account.emailUnconfirmedHint: A link to {{email}} shows that the address is yours.
account.signOutText: Ends your session in this browser. Your {{things}} stay as they are.
account.signOutProvider: You stay signed in at your sign-in provider; only {{app}} signs you out.
account.signOutPending_one: {{count}} change is not saved yet. If you sign out now, it is lost.
account.signOutPending_other: {{count}} changes are not saved yet. If you sign out now, they are lost.

ready.title: Ready for the internet?
ready.text: Many reach {{app}} from on the road as well. {{app}} checks this itself, each time you open the page.

address.title: Public address with https
address.ok: {{app}} is reached at {{address}}; passwords and cookies cross the network encrypted.
address.warn: {{address}} has https, but this request came without. Open {{app}} through that address, or let the proxy send X-Forwarded-Proto and put it into {{variable}}.
address.bad: Without https, passwords cross the network in the open, and web push and passkeys do not work at all. Enter the public address with https below.
address.missing: No public address yet. Enter the address with https below at which {{app}} is reached.

factorForAll.title: Second factor for everybody
factorForAll.ok: Whoever signs in with a password needs a code or a passkey as well.
factorForAll.bad: Off: a guessed or stolen password is enough to get into an account. Switch on “Require a second factor of everybody” below.
factorForAll.warn: Required of accounts with a password. At {{providers}} the provider checks the second factor itself, {{app}} asks none of its own there. Check that the provider really requires it.
factorForAll.off: {{variable}} is set: nobody is asked for a second factor. Remove the variable and restart {{app}}.

ownAccount.title: Your own account
ownAccount.bad: Has no second factor yet, and it may set everything. Set one up under My account › Security.

brake.title: Protection against guessing
brake.ok: 5 tries are free, after that each further one waits longer. After 10 wrong passwords the account is locked for 15 minutes. Every try is in the log.
brake.warn: All visitors come through a proxy {{app}} does not know: the pause holds per account, but per address only roughly. See “Behind the proxy”.
brake.bad: The list of trusted proxies holds public networks ({{networks}}). Anybody could then make up the sender's address, and the pause after wrong tries no longer holds. Enter only the address of your proxy.
brake.broken: The protection against guessing fails its own test. Restart {{app}}; if that does not help, please report it.

cookies.title: Sessions and cookies
cookies.ok_one: Cookies only over https and not readable by scripts; a sign-in ends after {{count}} day without use.
cookies.ok_other: Cookies only over https and not readable by scripts; a sign-in ends after {{count}} days without use.
cookies.warn: Without https the sign-in cookies travel in the open. Over https {{app}} protects them by itself.
cookies.bad: {{variable}} is off: the cookies go unprotected over https too. Set the value to auto.

proxy.title: Behind the proxy
proxy.ok: The visitors' real address arrives (proxy {{proxies}} entered as trusted). Without that, the protection against guessing would see everybody as one.
proxy.direct: The visitors arrive directly, without a proxy in between.
proxy.warn: The requests come through a proxy ({{proxy}}) that is not entered as trusted: the protection against guessing sees everybody as one. Set {{variable}} to its address.
proxy.bad: Public networks are entered as trusted ({{networks}}). Set {{variable}} to the address of your proxy, not to the whole internet.
